newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 27 Kurdish guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 27 Kurdish guerrillas.

text.p: Security forces have killed 27 Kurdish guerrillas in recent clashes in eastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Tuesday.
The office, based in the southeastern city of Diyarbakir, said in a statement that 18 Kurdish rebels were killed in Mardin province and nine died in a clash in the eastern province of Tunceli.
It did not say exactly when the clashes took place and gave no details of military casualties.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between security forces and the Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
